notes.title: Patch 38: New Loot System, MASSIVELY Buffed Loot, New Dungeon, Balance, and More
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/5824e63cba87d95baac636a7ce88b5d45ad414bd.png

With the release of the new Winter Prison dungeon and the introduction of Contribution Loot, this update brings exciting changes, bug fixes, and balancing to Darza's Dominion. Here's the full breakdown:

New Content


  Added the Winter Prison dungeon.
  Released the Winter Prison Pack.
  Added a new setpiece in the Frozen North, which drops the Winter Prison dungeon.
  Added the Contribution Loot system, incentivizing player involvement during boss encounters. To read more about Contribution Loot, here is how Typ described it.
  Contribution Points are awarded for hitting a boss during specific health segments.
  Damage Points are awarded based on the percentage of damage dealt.
  Healing Points are awarded based on the amount of healing provided during the encounter.
  Placement multipliers reward top performers, with solo players receiving top-tier rewards automatically.
  Converted Darza, Dungeon, Dominion Event Clock, and Seasonal Event bosses to Contribution Loot tables.
  Significantly adjusted loot rates and multipliers, with most changes being buffs.
  Added guaranteed top-tier drops for highest contributors.
  Replaced Gem Fragments with fully Fused Gems across all sources.
  Added bonus gems and adjusted drop rates for keys across various dungeons.


Balance Changes

  Removed Dexterity Bonus from Tiered Talismans.
  Changed Speed Bonus scaling for Tiered Talismans (t6: 4 → 5).
  Added an Armor Break Linger to Tiered Talismans, matching Fury and Invisibility durations.
  Reduced Invisibility Duration for Tiered Talismans (t0: 2.5s → 2.0s, t6: 5.5s → 5.0s).
  Reduced Cooldown Duration for Tiered Talismans (3.0+s → 2.0s above Invisible duration).
  Increased Mana Cost for all Tiered Talismans by 15.
  Reduced Projectile Speed for Tiered Daggers (18 → 16).

  Increased Max Health for Wyrm Rider (550 → 600).

  Increased effectiveness of Armored buffs on enemies (50% armor increase per level).
  Reduced the curve and speed of projectiles shot by Skeletal Vultures in Harbinger's Oblivion.
  Increased lifetime of Skeletal Vulture projectiles in Harbinger's Oblivion.
  Increased damage of enemies in Alien Outpost.
  Slightly increased amount of time between Big White Blasts during multiple States at Darza
  Reduced Duration of Bleeding from White Slash at Darza (1.4s → 0.6s)
  Increased Rotation Angle of White Slash Spiral during Spiral State at Darza (18 → 25)
  Increased amount of time between White Slash Spiral during Spiral State at Darza (0.07s → 0.1s)
  Reduced Projectile Count of Big White Blasts during Burst State at Darza (4 → 3-4)
  Increased Delay of State Change after Red States end at Darza (0.5-1.0s → 1-1.5s) for more downtime between States.
Increased Projectile Speed of  Big White Blasts at Darza (12 → 12.25)


Bug Fixes

  Fixed certain bosses dropping Hallowed Essence incorrectly.
  Fixed loot not dropping in some cases (e.g., potions).
  Fixed HP scaling on Granta's potion gifts.
  Fixed various memory leaks and crash issues.
  Fixed Rhino's movement (again).
  Fixed tooltip affixes now displaying icons.


Miscellaneous

  Added objective contribution points for idols in Harbinger's Oblivion and Shrine of Devas.
  Performance optimizations in the Dominion.
  Retired all attainments relating to Gem Fragments.
  Cardinal minibosses now respawn every 7.5–10 minutes.
  Updated behaviors for Old East's Champion miniboss.

notes.title: Patch 36: Vault Overhaul
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/8f2ec9edcdcb32f02456441d4b0a1c0a09f76470.png

Today we're releasing a brand new vault remake, as part of our quest to update all the areas players visit every day!

Cosmetic Vaults + Pet Vaults
We're introducing cosmetic vaults to store all your skins, hats, and textiles! Thank you to everyone who supports us—now you'll finally have a place to keep all your goodies. In addition to cosmetic vaults, we're also releasing pet vaults, which will allow you to store your pets. Both vaults are free of charge and each holds 16 items, giving you even more storage space!

Vault Changes

  Vaults now persist for 1 minute after leaving in case you accidentally drop something. A future patch will add a warning message.
  Vaults now save their purchase location. We don't want to know what you're doing with a single vault in the corner, but have fun!
  Increased max vaults to 200. This will be the final increase.
  Vault prices have been reduced to 299 gold per vault.
  The first vault purchase is now 99 gold, the second is 199 gold, and the third and all future purchases are 299 gold.
  Players now start with a total of 4 free vaults. All accounts will receive additional vault unlock tokens.
  Gift chests now hold 16 items each.


New Content

  Added the "Coil of Ka" beginner dungeon. Face off against Ka for new items and cosmetics! This dungeon features traps and a focus on dodging.


Balance Changes

  Changed the Bleeding debuff to Burning on Scorch Recurve.
  Increased debuff duration (2.5s → 4s) on Scorch Recurve.
  Changed the Bleeding debuff to Burning on Doobius Blazius.
  Decreased debuff level (3 → 1) on Doobius Blazius.
  Increased debuff duration (0.69s → 4.20s) on Doobius Blazius.


Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous

  Changed Alien Crystal Core and Pink Tree AoEs to no longer count against No Hit attainments.
  Fixed Rhino's movement (again).
  Added dungeon complete visuals to The Reach.
  The Hallowed Hunt event is now over. :) See you next year! We hope you all had fun!
  Retired all Halloween packages. Thank you so much for the incredible support!

notes.title: Update 4.0.1: 2 Starting Character Slots, Fairy Forest, Loot Shrines, and More!
notes.notes:
Our first content update in a number of years! This update is focused on a lot of quality of life improvements players have been requesting. Also included in the update is a new default of 2 starting character slots for new and existing players (up from 1), a new dungeon, a new boss in an existing dungeon, loot shrines, and more! As always, our Discord is the best place to stay up to date on latest changes.


Mobile News
For those of you who are playing our game for the first time, you may not know that we started out as a mobile game. We had aspirations of releasing on all platforms simultaneously but due to unforeseen issues, that was unfortunately not the case. We're excited for everyone to be able to play Darza's Dominion at home, on the go, [strike]in class[/strike], or anywhere you want!


With that said, we're happy to announce our intended, somewhat-firm-but-we're-0/10-on-mobile-release-dates, release date! Our targeted mobile release date on both iOS and Android is May 13th. Which happens to be Friday the 13th... spooky.

We want to make it clear the 13th is our best guess. It could come before or after. We will let everyone know on Discord if anything changes and when we can set the date in stone.

2 Character Slots Starting Out!
We've heard your feedback loud and clear and will be starting every account with 2 character slots instead of 1. Existing accounts will also be getting a free character slot in the form of a character slot unlocker! Use it to unlock whichever slot you choose. We initially wanted to go the route of a challenge to unlock this free slot but after feedback decided against it. Thanks as always for expressing your feedback constructively!

Fairy Forest
A new mid-tier dungeon has entered the Dominion! Fight through a mushroom and fairy laden forest to fight Adelphi, Lower Valkyrie! Will you survive what lies amongst the trees, or will Adelphi best you with her heavenly blade? Fight her now by killing enemies in the mountains!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/75c802691e70e893aef72d2449aa7dd7865856e1.gif

Loot Shrines
Before this update, players could buy 1 time use Loot Elixir potions that would increase their own personal loot chances for 30 minutes. We wanted to introduce a system that was less pay to win, and allowed everyone in the specific dungeon you are in to reap the rewards of our community's kindness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/04a04da88070534e8325cc9bb4d212cce5b4c6f7.gif

Introducing the Loot Shrine! In each dungeon you enter, there will be a Loot Shrine somewhere in the starting room. Anyone in that dungeon can contribute 15 gold per Loot Shrine level for a 10% increase in loot chance for all enemies in that dungeon. There are 5 levels of increase, totaling a 50% total increase in loot chance. Detailed below are the increases.


 Base: 100% loot chance
 Level 1: 110% loot chance (15 gold spent)
 Level 2: 120% loot chance (30 gold spent)
 Level 3: 130% loot chance (45 gold spent)
 Level 4: 140% loot chance (60 gold spent)
 Level 5: 150% loot chance (75 gold spent)


Class Item Changes
Mortars are receiving nerfs across the board (partially temporary until new tech for them is added):

 Radius through tiers is reduced (4.5 t0 / 4.5 t6 -> 2.0 t0 / 2.75 t6)
 Healing through tiers is reduced (70 t0 / 200 t6 -> 50 t0 / 180 t6)
 Mana Cost through tiers was standardized


Capes are receiving nerfs across the board:

 Effect radius through tiers is reduced (5 t0 / 6 t6 -> 3.25 t0 / 4 t6)
 Healing duration through tiers is reduced (2 t0 / 5 t6 -> 2 t0 / 3.5 t6)
 Mana costs have been reduced by 10 points on across tiers
 Self heal is 1.5 second longer than group healing duration


Darloc's Spite has been changed to hopefully become the go-to whip for DPS at the cost of some healing:

 Cooldown: 3.5 -> 1.5
 Damage: 500-690 -> 375-520
 Lifetime: 0.65 -> 0.75 (1 tile increase)
 Tether Duration: 3 -> 2


The Winter's Trinket, Betraying Hex, and Glacial Flurry have all been slightly reworked.

Ohtli enters the Ancient Ruins
Did you think the 2 puny Cicipaltis were menaces? Just wait until you fight Ohtli after them. Go on, give it your best shot! We know you're always up for a challenge.

Changelog
A non-exhaustive list of changes we've made. Visit our discord, linked above, for a complete and updated list.

Quality of Life Changes

 The nearby character list no longer automatically updates and pauses when your cursor is on it
